canonical_project: Orange Burkina Faso data center (Balkuy, Ouagadougou)
notes: Orange runs a data center at Balkuy, Ouagadougou. In March 2023 Orange Burkina Faso partnered with SolarX Group to solarize the facility, with panels covering ~37% of the site's requirements (local press reports deployments averaging ~1 MWp). Specifications and total MW capacity not disclosed. Orange Burkina Faso also peers at BFIX (PeeringDB network 11110).
